facts.fact: The Ministry of Social Solidarity, in a report carried by al-Masry al-Youm, says the social registry databases hold 13 million registered households, about half the population.

The ministry says Social Security Law 12 of 2025 adopted the programme's social registry databases as the unified source for all cash-transfer beneficiary databases in Egypt, serving Takaful and Karama.
The ministry says the registry is interlinked by national number with the databases of partner government bodies.
